rules.summary: Audit events have waited over two minutes for projection; the API relay may be stopped.
A workflow task has been queued for over ten minutes; check that a workflow worker is running.
A workflow worker stopped holding a lease; the stale sweep will reconcile it.
Some actions have unknown outcomes; follow the reconciliation runbook before retrying anything.
Some spend is unknown and is held against budgets until reconciled.
A budget envelope is overrun; new paid work in it is refused.
Webhook deliveries failed signature checks in the last day.
A paired local worker has stopped reporting; its jobs wait or reconcile, nothing is reassigned.
